name: My figure kit (Hanken Grotesk, with DM Mono for numbers)
source: The type styles of the figures in my essays. The figures for 'Type and colour have laws you can compute' are drawn from this file (pieces/s16/figures/render.mjs reads it).
licence: Personal. The typefaces are under the SIL Open Font Licence (fonts/FONTS.md).
note: Only two styles set their own line height; the others are single lines and leave it to the browser, so their line_px is null. With two line boxes there is too little to fit a band, so the file states the band both public scales fitted.

band.why: the band fitted to Tailwind CSS 4.2.2 and to IBM Carbon 11.70.0 in this pack (out/type.json)

steps.name: note
steps.role: the source note under a figure

steps.name: label
steps.role: the kicker and the column heads, set in capitals

steps.name: cell
steps.role: the small print in a table cell

steps.name: row
steps.role: the name of a table row
